lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: arc length, radian measure, and sector area derived from similarity
lessonRef.title: Guided practice B: arc length, radian measure, and sector area derived from similarity

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read once, then cover the example and try the guided set from memory.

items.prompt: Radius 6, central angle 60°. Arc and sector?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 45°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 74°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 3. From an external point 5 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 4, because the tangent bisects the radius
2, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
8, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
4, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency

items.prompt: A circle has radius 6. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 180°, in terms of π.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 68°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 38°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 8. From an external point 17 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 9, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
15, because the tangent bisects the radius
15, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
25, because the tangent extends beyond the circle

items.prompt: A circle has radius 12. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 120°, in terms of π.
